content_sections.heading: District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development, Raigarh Job Description
content_sections.text: केन्द्र प्रशासक Overall management and administrative coordination of the Sakhi One Stop Centre. Maintaining confidentiality of case files, victims' data, and sensitive information regarding cases. साईको-सोशल काउंसेलर Providing professional psychological counselling and support to women affected by violence. Maintaining confidential counselling records and reports within health and project parameters. केस वर्कर Managing cases of women affected by violence, documentation, and coordination with relevant domains and local resources. पैरा लीगल कार्मिक/वकील Providing legal counselling and assistance to women in coordination with the District Legal Services Authority or through legal expertise. कार्यालय सहायक Managing data processes, documentation, web-based reporting formats, and video conferencing at the centre. बहुउद्देशीय कर्मचारी/रसोइया Handling multi-purpose tasks and cooking duties at the centre. सुरक्षा गार्ड/नाईट गार्ड Providing security and night guard services at the Sakhi One Stop Centre premises.

Appointment is temporary and can be ended with one month's notice or one month's pay. Posts last only as long as the Mission Shakti scheme runs. Maternity leave is allowed.

Walk-in interview/skill test: 20 marks. Ties in merit are broken in favour of the older candidate.
